name: claude-statusline
description: Shows the claude-statusline info (model, effort, context window, 5h/7d quotas or reported session/monthly cost, repo/branch) in VS Code's status bar, for Claude Code chat-panel sessions.

claudeStatusline.showLocation.description: Also show the folder and repo:branch in the status bar (they're always in the tooltip).

claudeStatusline.barWidth.description: Width, in characters, of each usage progress bar.

claudeStatusline.contextWindowSize.description: Context window size in tokens. 0 = auto (1M for [1m] models, otherwise the size your terminal statusline has reported for that model, otherwise 200k).

claudeStatusline.usageView.description: What to show after the context window: 5h/7d quota bars (subscription) or money spent this session and this month (API). auto detects which one you're on.
